a.lede: Cisco released security updates to patch a denial-of-service zero-day in Adaptive Security Appliance (ASA) and Threat Defense (FTD) software that attackers are exploiting to remotely crash vulnerable firewall devices. [...]
a.title: New Cisco firewall zero-day exploited to crash SSL VPN devices

b.lede: The U.S. Cybersecurity and Infrastructure Security Agency (CISA) has added the PHP2Shell vulnerabilities to its catalog of actively exploited security flaws and ordered federal agencies to patch their systems by Thursday. [...]
b.title: CISA confirms PHP2Shell vulnerabilities now exploited in attacks
